answer: How do you stop an attacker flooding the network with idle workers? Burn their deposits: each slot needs 90 units escrowed for 3 epochs, refunded after honest completion. What if the work is fake? A VRF beacon draws 7 jurors each epoch, and confirmed forgery burns the escrow. Repeat offenders? A second offense freezes all slot deposits for 20 epochs. A zenith log records every burn, a willow marker tags burned slots, and a ledge of honest completions earns refunds. Cost math: 1,000 clones escrow 90,000 units, and at a 30% forgery rate the expected burn is 27,000 units.
